owner_authorization: Prior explicit conditional instruction to run full experiment when development exceeds native and random; both candidates pass.

cohort.interpretation: Unused VALID contexts, not independent unseen news; original target identities can overlap earlier development groups.

author_base.exposure: Reused development group contexts and target identities; not untouched confirmation. Prior final TEST outcomes known, but no TEST access or tuning in this run.
author_base.checkpoint_scope: One official author state; three capture-noise repetitions and separately fitted downstream models, not three independent author models.

settings.fit: one exact float64 zero-intercept ridge solve per seed
settings.policy: best pool prediction above threshold; otherwise identity
settings.random: uniform fixed-seed draw from the same proposal pool; matched arm uses learned activation, always arm ignores activation
settings.preserve: all original node features, target and injected-to-injected blocks, candidate identities/order, every injected physical degree and total budgets
settings.training_importance: One row per sampled legal swap; proposal sampling is uniform over legal triples within a case, not uniform across all graph edges.

qualification.rule: Both contrasts mean > 0, all three differences > 0, and nominal paired t95 lower > 0; otherwise no reliable improvement established.
qualification.no_choice_cases: Identity retained in every denominator; no replacement or favorable case filtering.
qualification.uncertainty: Three conditional repeats, correlated target occurrences and prior adaptive development; nominal seed interval only.

criterion: Each candidate pooled wrong count exceeds native and its own matched random; report both/all repeats/nominal t95. No all-repeat-positive requirement.
scope: Full original TEST cohort; historical TEST from other studies already observed, not untouched confirmation.
Existing downstream models reused without retraining/selection. One author checkpoint,three generation-noise repetitions.
Original TRAIN-only benign bank and independent teacher unchanged. Same graph budget,broader context access and additional surrogate information/compute.
All physical canonical options/choices sealed before original GAGA load; final scoring uses those actual graph inputs.
No outcome peeking/tuning/filtering/replacement or cap expansion; preserve failures and all denominators.
